content:
Copies the specified policy to one or more new custom policies. The new policies
created by the call will contain the same settings as the copied policy, but will not be
applied anywhere. Use Update Policy to apply the new policies to applications or
groups within apps. Requires "Grant resource - Write" API permission.
Note: This API call uses POST data, which must be represented as JSON and cannot be
passed in via URL parameters. Some Duo clients (Python or Java, for example) offer
helper functions to handle requests to the Admin API.
